purpose: Conditional public-data test of whether connected non-clique event structure changes fixed-q aggregate endpoints relative to pair and clique restrictions.
selection_rule: Use exactly the four completed time-only 4+12 views whose frozen outcome-blind geometry census reported a core-touching induced P3. Do not add windows after inspecting query values. The remaining four completed small views are complete cliques and remain in the denominator as geometry-ineligible for this conditional test.

families.ordered: Connected positive-overlap event with simultaneous occupancy at most C.
families.pair: Exactly two members under the same role and capacity rules.
families.clique: Pairwise positive overlap under the same role and capacity rules.

world_constraints: Every core exactly once, every buffer at most once, at least two rows and at least one core per event, and exactly q selected buffers.
outcome_rule: Selection and eligibility use only the frozen provider/time/zone projection. Miles are attached only after the projection and small-geometry hashes match the prior census. Observed duration is derived from the already selected exact pickup and dropoff times. Missing miles make only the affected query cell ineligible; rows are never replaced.
comparison_rule: For every declared C and q feasible in all three families, compare exact lower and upper endpoints at the same q. Preserve restricted-family infeasibility and equality. The primary distinctive comparison is ordered versus clique; ordered versus pair is secondary.
verification: Complete column and feasible-world enumeration, independent event replay, binary set-partitioning MILP verification and exact rational endpoint scoring. Timeout remains unresolved.
publication: Publish aggregate cells, hashes and witness hashes only. Keep row-level inputs in ignored scratch.
scope_limit: Conditional diagnostic on four outcome-blind non-clique small views from one frozen public calendar. It is not true event recovery, partner recall, population prevalence, city-scale closure or an independent holdout.
